teaser: Three times you walk the same aisle of the hardware store before picking the bolt, turning it over like it owes you an explanation. That is the 1 in you, wanting the exact right piece, and the ENFJ in you, picturing the shelf it will hold up for someone else. Life path 1 asks for a life built by your own hand, starting from nothing proven. ENFJ asks for people gathered close, carried, led somewhere better. Crossed together, you are a leader who cannot lead alone, and a guide who insists on doing the heavy lifting first.
